headline: BAL @ WSN matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is BAL 5.06 at WSN 4.23, with a projected total of 9.29. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward BAL: BAL moved +0.31 runs while WSN moved -0.97, changing the projected margin by +1.28 runs. The projected total fell -0.66, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -7.1%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Miles Mikolas has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.6 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Samuel Basallo, Daylen Lile, CJ Abrams, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Jorbit Vivas, Nasim Nuñez because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
